files.content:
<!-- Code generated by packages/kit-compose/src/organisms.ts from packages/compose-gen/specs (compose-gen organism emitters on kit-compose). DO NOT EDIT. -->
<!--
  A panel with a chart of one series: vertical bars with captions, or meter rows with a percent. Axes: chart
  (bars, meters), size (default, compact), tone (default, muted).
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { Point } from "./chart-panel.types";

export type ChartPanelProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  text: string;
  series: Point[];
  empty?: string;
  summary: string;
  percent: string;
  chart?: "bars" | "meters";
  size?: "default" | "compact";
  tone?: "default" | "muted";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import Block from "../compose/Block.vue";
import Container from "../compose/Container.vue";
import Stack from "../compose/Stack.vue";
import BarChart from "../components/bar-chart.vue";
import EmptyState from "../components/empty-state.vue";
import MeterRow from "../components/meter-row.vue";
import Panel from "../components/panel.vue";
import { tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  text,
  series,
  empty = "",
  summary,
  percent,
  chart = "bars",
  size = "default",
  tone = "default",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<ChartPanelProps>();
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="section"
    :aria-labelledby="(landmarkLabel ? undefined : ((title && id) ? tpl('{0}-t', id) : undefined))"
    data-testid="panel-section"
    :aria-label="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4 py-8" data-slot="container">
      <Panel :title="title" :description="text" :id="id" :class="(((tone as string) === 'muted') ? 'bg-muted' : '')">
        <EmptyState v-if="((series?.length ?? 0) === 0)" icon="chart-column" :title="empty" />
        <BarChart
          v-else-if="((chart as string) === 'bars')"
          :bars="series"
          :label="summary"
          :height="(((size as string) === 'compact') ? 96 : 176)"
        />
        <Stack v-else :gap="(((size as string) === 'compact') ? '0' : '2')" align="stretch" data-testid="items">
          <MeterRow
            v-for="s in series"
            :key="s.id"
            :label="s.label"
            :value="s.value"
            :caption="tpl(percent, s.value)"
          />
        </Stack>
      </Panel>
    </Container>
  </Block>
</template>
